# Synthetic Markup Safety Fixture

## Citation Payload
This generated text includes inert markup for citation packaging tests: <script>alert('synthetic')</script> and <b>bold synthetic marker</b>.

## Expected Handling
Citation packaging must return plain text only. Script-like text must not become executable markup and must not be treated as trusted formatting.

## Safety Boundary
This fixture is synthetic generated content only and exists to test excerpt sanitization.
